item.title: Gas crosses $4 a gallon in the U.S. for the first time in 3 years
item.summary: The war with Iran has driven up gas prices at a time when affordability is high on people's minds.

item.title: Trump tells Europe 'Go get your own oil,' Iran hits oil tanker off Dubai
item.summary: Iran attacked and set on fire a massive Kuwaiti oil tanker off Dubai overnight, as Gulf states increasingly suffer the fallout from the war.

item.title: How Trump's EEOC is attacking DEI and emphasizing white people
item.summary: Andrea Lucas, the Trump-appointed chair of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, has set a new agenda for an agency that long prioritized vulnerable and underserved workers.

item.title: Supreme Court strikes Colorado ban on conversion therapy
item.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that Colorado's law banning conversion therapy "regulates speech based on viewpoint."

item.title: Domino, the warty frogfish, is the first of its kind to be raised in captivity
item.summary: Scientists say the little fish may hold broader lessons for raising other marine species in captivity.

item.title: Former Alex Jones employee says: 'It was nonsense, it was lies'
item.summary: Josh Owens spent four years as a video editor and field producer for Jones' Infowars media company. "It was all about making things look cinematic," he says. Owens' memoir is The Madness of Believing.

item.title: 6 books named finalists for the 2026 International Booker Prize
item.summary: The shortlisted titles include novels and novellas from authors and translators spanning four continents, with stories that range from Japanese-controlled 1930s Taiwan to the streets of Tehran in 1979.

item.title: In a town close to the farmworker movement, some struggle to process Chavez allegations
item.summary: March 31 is Cesar Chavez's birthday, and a longtime holiday. In the wake of sexual assault allegations against him, residents in the farming town of Delano are conflicted about how to remember him.

item.title: 'The Keeper' is a grand finale to Tana French's Cal Hooper crime series
item.summary: Set in a quaint Irish village, The Keeper follows The Searcher and The Hunter, and solidifies the crime series' status as a contemporary classic.

item.title: The final batch of World Cup tickets is about to go on sale. Here are 5 things to know
item.summary: FIFA is kicking off its last sales for World Cup tickets on Wednesday. From prices to why FOMO is working against you, here's what you need to know.
